title: भीमफेदी दुर्घटनाबारे छानबिन गर्न समिति गठन, यथाशीघ्र क्षतिपूर्ति उपलब्ध गराइने सरकारको आश्वासन
content:
No ads found for this position काठमाडौं । मकवानपुरको भीमफेदीमा बिहीबार भएको यात्रुवाहक सवारी दुर्घटनाको छानबिन गर्न ५ सदस्यीय समिति गठन गरिएको छ । विभिन्न माग राख्दै मृतकका आफन्तले शव बुझ्न मानिरहेका छैनन् । उनीहरूले हेटौंडा अस्पतालमा धर्ना दिइरहँदा सरकारले विज्ञप्तिमार्फत् धारणा सार्वजनिक गरेको हो । प्रधानमन्त्री तथा मन्त्रिपरिषद्को कार्यालयले शुक्रबार एक प्रेस विज्ञप्ति जारी गर्दै मकवानपुरका सहायक प्रमुख जिल्ला अधिकारीको संयोजकत्वमा सात दिनभित्र प्रतिवेदन पेस गर्ने गरी छानबिन समिति गठन गरिएको जानकारी दिएको हो । दुर्घटनाको वास्तविक कारण पहिचान गरी आगामी दिनमा यस्ता घटना दोहोरिन नदिन आवश्यक सुझावसहितको प्रतिवेदन तयार पार्न समिति गठन गरिएको कार्यालयका सहसचिव एवं प्रवक्ता हेमराज अर्यालद्वारा जारी विज्ञप्तिमा उल्लेख छ । त्यस्तै, सवारी तथा यातायात व्यवस्था ऐन, २०४९ तथा प्रचलित बिमा कानुनअनुसार घाइतेहरूको उपचार खर्च र मृतकका परिवारले प्राप्त गर्ने क्षतिपूर्ति तथा बिमा रकम यथाशीघ्र उपलब्ध गराउन सम्बन्धित सवारीधनी, यातायात व्यवसायी र बिमा कम्पनीसँग समन्वय गरी आवश्यक प्रक्रिया अघि बढाइएको विज्ञप्तिमा जनाइएको छ। बिहीबार बिहान भीमफेदी गाउँपालिका–६, चिसापानीगढीस्थित भीमफेदी-कुलेखानी-काठमाडौं सडकखण्डमा काठमाडौं-सर्लाही रुटमा सञ्चालन भएको मधेश प्रदेश ०३–००१ ज ०८८० नम्बरको सवारी साधन अनियन्त्रित भई सडकबाट करिब ५०० मिटर तल खस्दा १४ जनाको ज्यान गएको थियो भने ६ जना घाइते भएका थिए। छठ पर्व मनाउन घर जाने क्रममा दुर्घटनामा परी ज्यान गुमाउने यात्रुमध्ये १३ जना सर्लाहीको चक्रघट्टा गाउँपालिका–४, सुन्दरपुरका र एकजना चालक कविलासी नगरपालिकाका बासिन्दा छन् । सरकारले दुर्घटनामा घाइते भएकाहरूको उपचारलाई उच्च प्राथमिकतामा राखेको र स्वास्थ्योपचारमा कुनै कमी हुन नदिन सम्बन्धित अस्पताललाई आवश्यक निर्देशन दिइसकेको जनाएको छ । घाइतेमध्ये तीनजना उपचारपछि डिस्चार्ज भइसकेका छन् भने बाँकी तीनजनाको चितवनस्थित मनकामना अस्पताल र ललितपुरस्थित मेडिसिटी अस्पतालमा उपचार भइरहेको छ । Kathmandu: A five-member committee has been formed to investigate the passenger vehicle accident that occurred in Bhimphedi, Makawanpur on Thursday. The relatives of the deceased are refusing to accept the body, making various demands. The government has made its position public through a press release while they are staging a sit-in at Hetauda Hospital. The Office of the Prime Minister and Council of Ministers issued a press release on Friday, stating that an investigation committee has been formed under the coordination of the Assistant Chief District Officer of Makawanpur to submit a report within seven days. A statement issued by the office's Joint Secretary and Spokesperson Hemraj Aryal states that a committee has been formed to identify the real cause of the accident and prepare a report with necessary suggestions to prevent such incidents from recurring in the future. Similarly, the press release states that necessary procedures have been taken forward in coordination with the concerned vehicle owners, transport entrepreneurs and insurance companies to provide the treatment expenses of the injured and the compensation and insurance amount to the families of the deceased as soon as possible, in accordance with the Vehicle and Transport Management Act, 2049 BS and the prevailing insurance law. On Thursday morning, 14 people were killed and six others were injured when a vehicle (Madhesh Pradesh 03-001 Ja 0880) operating on the Kathmandu-Sarlahi route lost control and fell about 500 meters off the road on the Bhimphedi-Kulekhani-Kathmandu road section in Bhimphedi Rural Municipality-6, Chisapanigadhi, Bhimphedi Rural Municipality. Among the passengers who lost their lives in an accident while returning home to celebrate Chhath festival, 13 are from Sundarpur, Chakraghatta Rural Municipality-4, Sarlahi, and one driver is a resident of Kavilasi Municipality. The government has given top priority to the treatment of those injured in the accident and has issued necessary instructions to the concerned hospitals to ensure that there is no shortage of healthcare. Three of the injured have been discharged after treatment, while the remaining three are being treated at Manakamana Hospital in Chitwan and Medicity Hospital in Lalitpur.

छठ पर्व मनाउन घर जाने क्रममा दुर्घटनामा परी ज्यान गुमाउने यात्रुमध्ये १३ जना सर्लाहीको चक्रघट्टा गाउँपालिका–४, सुन्दरपुरका र एकजना चालक कविलासी नगरपालिकाका बासिन्दा छन् ।

सरकारले दुर्घटनामा घाइते भएकाहरूको उपचारलाई उच्च प्राथमिकतामा राखेको र स्वास्थ्योपचारमा कुनै कमी हुन नदिन सम्बन्धित अस्पताललाई आवश्यक निर्देशन दिइसकेको जनाएको छ । घाइतेमध्ये तीनजना उपचारपछि डिस्चार्ज भइसकेका छन् भने बाँकी तीनजनाको चितवनस्थित मनकामना अस्पताल र ललितपुरस्थित मेडिसिटी अस्पतालमा उपचार भइरहेको छ ।

Kathmandu: A five-member committee has been formed to investigate the passenger vehicle accident that occurred in Bhimphedi, Makawanpur on Thursday. The relatives of the deceased are refusing to accept the body, making various demands. The government has made its position public through a press release while they are staging a sit-in at Hetauda Hospital. The Office of the Prime Minister and Council of Ministers issued a press release on Friday, stating that an investigation committee has been formed under the coordination of the Assistant Chief District Officer of Makawanpur to submit a report within seven days. A statement issued by the office's Joint Secretary and Spokesperson Hemraj Aryal states that a committee has been formed to identify the real cause of the accident and prepare a report with necessary suggestions to prevent such incidents from recurring in the future. Similarly, the press release states that necessary procedures have been taken forward in coordination with the concerned vehicle owners, transport entrepreneurs and insurance companies to provide the treatment expenses of the injured and the compensation and insurance amount to the families of the deceased as soon as possible, in accordance with the Vehicle and Transport Management Act, 2049 BS and the prevailing insurance law. On Thursday morning, 14 people were killed and six others were injured when a vehicle (Madhesh Pradesh 03-001 Ja 0880) operating on the Kathmandu-Sarlahi route lost control and fell about 500 meters off the road on the Bhimphedi-Kulekhani-Kathmandu road section in Bhimphedi Rural Municipality-6, Chisapanigadhi, Bhimphedi Rural Municipality. Among the passengers who lost their lives in an accident while returning home to celebrate Chhath festival, 13 are from Sundarpur, Chakraghatta Rural Municipality-4, Sarlahi, and one driver is a resident of Kavilasi Municipality. The government has given top priority to the treatment of those injured in the accident and has issued necessary instructions to the concerned hospitals to ensure that there is no shortage of healthcare. Three of the injured have been discharged after treatment, while the remaining three are being treated at Manakamana Hospital in Chitwan and Medicity Hospital in Lalitpur.
